question:
Refer to the exhibit. An engineer must configure FCoE between the N9K-A switch and the FCF-A Nexus 9000 core switch. The deployment has these characteristics:
- The N9K-A and N9K-B top-of-rack switches share the domain ID of the core switches.
- The hosts are equipped with converged network adapters.
- The only VSAN that is used is permitted to traverse port-channel 100 is VSAN 20.
Which configuration completes the FCoE configuration on the N9K-A device?
context: Topology: SAN A / LAN / SAN B clouds connect to FCF-A and FCF-B (N9K core switches). FCF-A/FCF-B connect via port-channel 100 (VSAN 20) to FCoE top-of-rack switches N9K-A and N9K-B. Host A and Host B connect to both N9K-A and N9K-B via unified I/O (FC, 10G Ethernet, Unified I/O, FCoE links).
imageNote: Diagram: SAN A, LAN, and SAN B clouds connect to FCF-A and FCF-B (N9K core switches), which link via port-channel 100 (VSAN 20) down to FCoE top-of-rack switches N9K-A and N9K-B; Host A and Host B connect to both N9K-A and N9K-B using FC, 10G Ethernet, and FCoE links.
options:
N9K-A(config)# feature-set fcoe-npv
N9K-A(config)# interface vfc-port-channel 100
N9K-A(config-if)# switchport mode E
N9K-A(config-if)# switchport trunk allowed vsan 1, 20

N9K-A(config)# feature-set fcoe-npv
N9K-A(config)# interface vfc-port-channel 100
N9K-A(config-if)# switchport mode NP
N9K-A(config-if)# switchport trunk allowed vsan 20

N9K-A(config)# feature fcoe
N9K-A(config)# feature npv
N9K-A(config)# interface vfc 100
N9K-A(config-if)# bind interface port-channel 100
N9K-A(config-if)# switchport mode N
N9K-A(config-if)# switchport allowed vsan 20

N9K-A(config)# feature fcoe
N9K-A(config)# feature npv
N9K-A(config)# interface vfc 100
N9K-A(config-if)# bind interface port-channel 100
N9K-A(config-if)# switchport mode F
N9K-A(config-if)# switchport trunk allowed vsan 20
theory: When top-of-rack Nexus 9000 switches share the domain ID of the core FCF switches instead of running their own full FCF, they operate as FCoE NPV (an FCoE analogue of native FC NPV): the feature-set 'fcoe-npv' is enabled, and the uplink toward the FCF core is configured as an NP-type virtual interface (here a vfc-port-channel in mode NP, mirroring how a native NPV edge switch uses NP ports toward its NPIV core), with only the required VSAN (20) permitted on the trunk. Using F or E port modes would be wrong because N9K-A is acting as a proxy/edge switch relaying logins upstream, not terminating them as a full fabric switch. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 9 - FCoE NPV)
